results.title: Wigan Warriors go level with Leeds Rhinos after convincing win at Bradford Bulls
results.description: Wigan Warriors moved level on points with Super League leaders Leeds Rhinos after cruising to a 34-6 victory over Bradford Bulls at Bartercard Odsal Stadium on Saturday.
